verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents generating sensor data from cameras, depth sensors, lidar, IMU and more, with optional noise and OGRE v2 realistic rendering. That covers part of the synthetic-data half of the story. It also supports headless, GUI-free server runs suited to CI and remote execution, but nothing documents reinforcement learning workflows or running at scale. missing for 10: RL framework/gym integration, parallel or vectorized environments for scale, domain randomization and labeled dataset export tooling, independent corroboration.
